notes: Safari on this host surfaced a TLS trust interstitial for https://uitestingplayground.com; deterministic benchmark execution used the directly served http endpoint.
The click module requires a physical-like click event; solver dispatches a mouse event with non-zero screen coordinates.
Dynamic table parsing is ARIA-structure aware and computes Chrome CPU by Name/CPU header index mapping to remain correct under column reorder.
Sample App login solver targets #login explicitly and uses semantic field selectors to avoid navbar button collisions and dynamic ID churn.
